top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a dated, falsifiable prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic angle, 2011) followed by the 2018 observation of correlated insulating and superconducting states, reproduced by many groups and opening a tunable platform for strongly correlated matter. The three-name allocation maps onto distinct roles, and the citation can be limited to flat bands and correlated phases without taking a side on the pairing mechanism. Maturity and the omission of Cao's team are real costs, but they do not outweigh the breadth of the discovery. P003 is the mature, cleanly credited fallback, and P002 ranks below it because the single-name IceCube credit lacks an agreed principle.
